profile.headline: Software Engineer | Certified Scrum Master
profile.summary: Recent graduate of Delaware State University with 5+ years of customer service experience in retail, food & beverage, and banking. As well as 2 years in data entry and collection. With this experience, I am skilled in Microsoft Word and Excel, detail-oriented, and analytical problem solving . Currently in a Software Development program with CODE Differently, gaining knowledge to strengthen my technical skills in software development and learning the Java programming language. Look forward to connecting and growing in the tech industry.

positions.title: Management Analyst
positions.description: Analyze data gathered, developed, and implemented solutions or alternative methods of proceeding while supporting the Research and Evaluation Department within the Department of Health and Social Services (DHSS). Evaluate the effectiveness of operations for meeting established goals and objectives. Use Microsoft Excel to maintain data after quality checks were performed. Draft procedural manuals, training materials, and routine reports with updated implementations from the results of research.

positions.title: Data Entry Clerk
positions.description: Input serial number, propane monitors and tester information into industry specific software in preparation for annual audit, which I doubled productivity. Performed analytical research and quality assurance on physical files of accounts that were missing key information for data entry into computer. Collaborate with customer service department in updating client information as needed.

positions.title: Stage Manager
positions.description: Responsible for running auditions and callbacks both virtual and in-person. Attended all rehearsals and assisted in rehearsal operation (ie: setting up the stage, cast attendance, creation of prompt book, recording director’s blocking). Maintained the show page on Virtual Callboard, including but not limited to updating rehearsals, and filing timely rehearsal/performance reports. Managed and ran shows from beginning of tech rehearsal to closing night as well as call all cues and operate light board cues. Documented all personnel and scenery movement to create accurate charts, lists, and training material.

positions.title: Customer Service Representative
positions.description: Following strict procedures and compliances, I assisted customers with inquiries, account status and problem resolution. Processed correspondence in an accurate and timely manner. Performed miscellaneous tasks as assigned, such as but not limited to, creating monthly quota presentations as well as support in maintaining quarterly newsletter. Strengthened legal and operational compliance by strictly following all company policies and procedures. Built organizational skills to manage resources and locate references to maximize efficiency. Contributed to increasing Customer Satisfaction scores.

positions.title: Customer Support Specialist
positions.description: Received inbound calls regarding Health Saving Accounts and support for HSA Debit Cards issued to clients. Provided navigational support of our website in order to promote new technologies and banking platforms that are offered by the BNY Mellon brand. Initiated fraud and dispute claims that were then transferred over to the Fraud department. Provided detailed knowledge of HSA and investment banking products and strictly adhering to corporate compliance. Continuously went above and beyond for clients regarding issues with their debit cards in order to drive customer satisfaction.
